name: SAB'AT AL-DEEMIN
description: Sab'at Al-Deemin (7 of Diamonds) is a domino partition game where players divide dominoes into groups of seven with the 7 pip as the central pivot. Strategic play involves managing your hand and outmaneuvering opponents.

content.text: Sab'at Al-Deemin (7 of Diamonds) is a domino partition game where players divide dominoes into groups of seven with the 7 pip as the central pivot. Strategic play involves managing your hand and outmaneuvering opponents.

Country/Region of Origin: Saudi Arabia
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: The Saudi game Sab'at Al-Deemin (7 of Diamonds) is related to Fan Tan/Sevens; played as a partnership game with enhanced scoring.
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game in Saudi Arabia and the region.
